summary: The AI command object at group+564Ch, built for the first time in this process. The factory 00A13340 has exactly one caller and its ten arms were re-read from the listing, confirming ai_tail_command_recipe row for row. The ten vtable slots are settled by dumping 00D22968-00D22C68: +10h is 00A0FC50 in all sixteen classes and +24h is 00A0FC90, RET 8, in all sixteen, so no class acts on a member notification. 00A2C790 was read in full: the +114h slot is the MEMBER entity's, not the command's, and the pass reports the member's weapon director state to a command that discards it, then ticks the command on a uniform 2-4 s schedule. The host now installs the birth NONCONTROL/IDLE command, replaces it on an attack order, rebinds it on a merge and answers the auto-merge predicate for real.

validation.attribution: can_auto_merge and group_member_pass both go from UNIMPLEMENTED to concrete at the same call counts (23990 and 11996 per mission), so the phases were always reached and only the answers changed. 204 ticks over four groups and 103 over two is 51 per group in 150 s, one every 2.9 s, inside the 2.0-4.0 s band 00A0FC50 supplies: run-time evidence for the interval constants. The gunnery and first_command shifts come from random_interval drawing the command schedule from the same stand-in generator as the party think; no gunnery code changed.
validation.merges_still_zero: Every pair containing a MOVETOATTACK group is rejected by class, through the default 00A0FC80. The remaining same-party NONCONTROL/IDLE pairs are rejected by one of the six tests of 00A11F80/00A12450, and which one was not instrumented. Partial.

uncertainties: The per-class vt+0Ch tick was not read. 00A10EC0, 00A10DC0 and 00A11070 are the three helpers NONCONTROL and IDLE share, and the eleven class-specific bodies were not opened, so whether a MOVETO or DEFENDPOSITION ever reaches a unit as a scene command is still unsettled. Coverage: partial.
The factory allocates eight bytes for DEFENDPOSITION and RETREAT although their family carries a third base at +20h. Read as such at 00A1372F and 00A1375B, not explained.
CAUTIOUSMOVE is allocated 20h by the factory while docs/AI_PLANNERS.md places its third two-slot base at +20h, which would need 2Ch. One of the two is imprecise; the size is what the listing shows.
Which entity classes the ids 0x1B, 0x45 and 0x46 of 009FE0B0 name was not resolved.
member_weapon_director has no director object to return in this process, so a live unit stands in for a non-null pointer. Labelled substitution.
release_group_reference reverts a command whose target was released to the group's birth class; the native leaves a dangling command+1Ch. Labelled substitution.

00A10D50 compares AiLeaderWeight through the adjustor thunk 009FFD70, whose contract is unread; this process substitutes the leader's unit index, which orders a pair consistently but is not the native strength. The merge counts below are therefore evidence that the predicate now runs, not that it answers what the native would.
